NewsArticle.Title: The Fair
NewsArticle.Content: .07.16 Events: - The King's Hunts, for Lower and Higher Circles - The Scavenger Hunt - A Medieval Murder Mystery - The Trivia Contest - Storytelling - Plays - Dance Troupe Performances - The Fashion Show - Booths - Classes and Demonstrations - Auction of the King's Dog Details are subject to change, check latest information, details, and become involved at: [The Fair Information Site](http://www.crosswinds.net/~thefair/) Bids for the King's Dog may consider item, as well as gold, bids, provided an Aisling auctioneer can facilitate assessing the value of items.
